lead.headline: MRPL blast: police register case against two officials as refinery inquiry begins
lead.deck: One worker died and nine were hurt when a cold separator ruptured at the Jokatte refinery on Wednesday.
body: A day after the blast and fire at the Coker Hydrotreater Unit of Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (MRPL) near Jokatte, reports say the police have registered a case against two MRPL officials following a complaint. MRPL said a high-pressure cold separator ruptured around midday on Wednesday, 30 September, and a fire followed.

One person died and nine were injured, according to the reports. The man who died was a 30-year-old worker from Mulki. One report says the fire was fully put out by about 2.45 pm. Early counts differed (eight injured in the first reports, nine later), so the paper uses the later figure.
Reports on the condition of the injured differ, so this paper does not give a verdict on any one patient. Official statements from MRPL and the police will be followed in the coming days.

stories.title: Mangaluru railway area moves to Mysuru division from 1 October
stories.text: The railway network up to and including Ullal passes from the Palakkad Division of Southern Railway to the Mysuru Division of South Western Railway from 1 October. Reports say the region accounts for nearly 90 per cent of the Palakkad division's freight revenue, and the change is expected to help rake availability for industry.

stories.title: Yellow alert for heavy rain on the coast
stories.text: A yellow alert covering 12 districts of coastal, Malnad and south interior Karnataka was issued for Wednesday 30 September and Thursday 1 October, with heavy downpours and thunderstorms likely at isolated places in Dakshina Kannada and Udupi. The five-day forecast on this page shows how the week looks.

stories.title: Fisherman missing after falling into the sea
stories.text: A 28-year-old fisherman from Chhattisgarh, Dwarika Shikar, is reported missing after falling overboard from a Persian fishing boat that left Malpe harbour with other boats on 25 September.

stories.title: SIT to begin fresh probe in the Soujanya case
stories.text: The Special Investigation Team set up by the Karnataka government to reinvestigate the 2012 Soujanya case is to start its probe in Mangaluru on Thursday. It has been given three months to complete the work and report to the competent court.

stories.title: Tulu film 'Bellada Gatti': Udupi premiere sold out
stories.text: Tickets for the Udupi premiere show of Raja Katapady's Tulu film 'Bellada Gatti' sold out. The show is on 1 October at 6.15 pm at Bharat Mall, Times Square Mall.

stories.title: Foreign tourist found in distress, handed to Goa police
stories.text: A Russian national found collapsed on the Kallianpur-Santhekatte service road was produced before the district court and handed over to the Goa police. Police found his entry permit had expired and a case against him was pending in Goa.

stories.title: Mangalore University drops 16 postgraduate programmes
stories.text: Mangalore University has temporarily discontinued 16 postgraduate programmes for 2026-27 because they did not attract the minimum number of students.

stories.title: Credit society opens Bajpe branch tomorrow
stories.text: The Bantwal Catholic Credit Co-operative Society's Bajpe branch is scheduled to open on 2 October.

briefly: Mangaluru: the railway area up to Ullal moves to Mysuru division of South Western Railway from today.
Konkan route: Mangaluru Central-Madgaon passenger (56616) leaving on 1 October is short-terminated at Karwar.
Udupi: yellow alert for heavy rain and thunderstorms in isolated places.
Bajpe: the Bantwal Catholic Credit Co-operative Society opens a branch tomorrow, 2 October.

sports.headline: India chase 406 to win the second ODI; hockey semifinal against Pakistan today

items.title: 2nd ODI: India chase 406 to win by 8 wickets
items.text: India reached 406 for 2 in 43.3 overs, with 39 balls to spare, after West Indies made 405 for 7 at Guwahati on 30 September. Shubman Gill scored 223 off 133 balls and Rohit Sharma 101 off 75; Ruturaj Gaikwad was not out on 31. West Indies' innings had centuries from Jangoo (114), Hope (104) and Campbell (101). India lead the three-match series 2-0.
items.source: ESPNcricinfo and Outlook India match reports

items.title: Day 13: hockey and cricket semifinals
items.text: India's men play Pakistan in the hockey semifinal and Sri Lanka in the cricket semifinal on 1 October. After Day 12, India had 10 gold, 21 silver and 28 bronze medals and stood seventh in the table. Archery, shooting, cycling and squash offer medal chances today.

items.title: Women's hockey team into the final
items.text: India's women's hockey team beat South Korea 2-0 to reach the Asian Games final, where they will face China for gold.

items.title: Both kabaddi teams won gold
items.text: India's men's and women's kabaddi teams both won gold at the Asian Games; the kabaddi tournament ended on 26 September.
items.source: Wikipedia, Kabaddi at the 2026 Asian Games
